description: CAT-P, two repairs. (1) On a fresh database with the TableDefs, Fields, Indexes and QueryDefs collections refreshed (the earlier probes reused a stale collection), a custom Long property is appended to the Database, the TableDef, a Field, an Index and a QueryDef; the database is closed, reopened read-only and each property is read by name (Type, Value). (2) Reopened read/write: BeginTrans, the Database property is set to 999, a second property is appended, both are read, then Rollback; the same handle is read after Properties.Refresh and a second Workspace's Database is read. Asks whether property changes roll back, and what the held handle shows.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
